shortDescription: Module for create, update and delete of single instance database. Currently, postgres type database is officially supported.

options.name: auto_tune_staging_drive
options.description: enable/disable auto tuning of stage drive enabled by default

options.name: automated_patching
options.description: configure automated patching using maintenance windows

options.name: db_params_profile
options.description: DB parameters profile details

options.name: db_server_cluster
options.description: configure db server cluster required when creating HA instance for postgres, max two HA proxy nodes are allowed for postgres, minimum three database nodes are required

options.name: db_uuid
options.description: uuid for update or delete of database instance will be used to update if C(state) is C(present) and to delete if C(state) is C(absent)

options.name: db_vm
options.description: DB server VM details

options.name: delete_db_from_vm
options.description: to be used with C(state) = absent delete database data from vm

options.name: delete_db_server_vms
options.description: to be used with C(state) = absent this will delete DB server vms or DB server cluster of database instance

options.name: delete_time_machine
options.description: to be used with C(state) = absent delete time machine as well in delete process

options.name: desc
options.description: description of database update allowed

options.name: name
options.description: name of database instance update allowed

options.name: nutanix_debug
options.description: Enable detailed debug logging for all API calls made by this module. When enabled, logs will include HTTP method, URL, headers, request body, response body, status code, and elapsed time. Authorization headers and sensitive information are automatically redacted. This parameter can also be set via the NUTANIX_DEBUG environment variable and is preferred over the NUTANIX_DEBUG environment variable.

options.name: nutanix_host
options.description: ndb era server IP address C(nutanix_host). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_HOST), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_log_file
options.description: The file to write the logs to. This parameter can also be set via the NUTANIX_LOG_FILE environment variable and is preferred over the NUTANIX_LOG_FILE environment variable.

options.name: nutanix_password
options.description: ndb era server password C(nutanix_password). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_PASSWORD), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_username
options.description: ndb era server username C(nutanix_username). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_USERNAME), environment variable is used.

options.name: postgres
options.description: action arguments for postgres type database

options.name: soft_delete
options.description: to be used with C(state) = absent unregister from ndb without any process if not provided, database instance from db server VM will be deleted

options.name: state
options.description: Specify state If C(state) is set to C(present) then the operation will be  create the item If C(state) is set to C(absent) and if the item exists, then item is removed.

options.name: tags
options.description: dict of tag name as key and tag value as value update allowed during update, given input will override existing tags

options.name: time_machine
options.description: time machine details

options.name: timeout
options.description: timeout for polling database operations in seconds default is 2100 secs i.e. 35 minutes

options.name: unregister_db_server_vms
options.description: to be used with C(state) = absent this will unregister DB server vms or DB server cluster of database instance

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Set value to C(False) to skip validation for self signed certificates This is not recommended for production setup C(validate_certs). If not set then the value of the C(VALIDATE_CERTS), environment variable is used.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the  CRUD operation to complete.
